en:
Good morning, Kaede! Good morning, Shuichi!
You finally come!
Huh? Did we promise to meet up?
No, nobody promise...

Gonta thought, everyone come here again.
Like yesterday morning and morning before that.
But Gonta not see anyone. Except Kirumi...

Oh, I see... So no one met up in here
this morning.

<CLT=cltMIND>Does this mean everyone wants to go their
separate ways?
Where's Kirumi?

Kirumi make Gonta breakfast...
Then she leave to clean dormitory.

<CLT=cltMIND>She's cleaning our rooms? Has she been doing
that since we came to this place?

Hey, eat breakfast with Gonta! Breakfast
is important meal for gentleman!
Sorry, I can't right now...
Huh...? You not wanna be with Gonta?

No, that's not it! I promised to meet up
with Miu, that's all!
Oh! Sorry! Gonta act selfish...

<CLT=cltMIND>Phew... Gonta made such a scary face all
of a sudden, my heart skipped a beat!

Gonta stay here little longer.
Maybe someone else come.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
But there's nothing displayed right now.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Dining Hall Rules"

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"You may eat any food you
find in the dining hall."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Please take responsibility for all utensils and
dishes used and clean up after yourself."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"The dining hall will be locked
during nighttime."
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>This door was blocked before...
When did it become accessible?
